card.name: Inside spaced or capitalized section headings
card.fires_on: Letters or pieces inside all-caps or letter-spaced label headings, especially DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION, and other capitalized warning titles. It also fires on odd breaks inside such text, like a hyphen or bracket.

modes.description: Single letters inside a heading written with spaces or broken letters, such as ADMINISTRATION.
